about.taglineFallback: Empowering Homes and Businesses with Smart Automation Solutions across India and beyond.
about.descriptionFallback: {{name}} specializes in smart automation products — smart switches, digital locks, gateways, sensors, smart knobs, and intelligent control systems — designed for homes, offices, hotels, hospitals, educational institutions, and industrial environments.
about.commitment: Our commitment to quality and innovation has made us a trusted name in the automation industry, delivering solutions that genuinely transform how people live and work.
about.missionDesc: To provide innovative, secure, energy-efficient, and user-friendly automation solutions that improve everyday life for homes and businesses everywhere.
about.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about our products, installation process, warranty, and smart automation services.
about.joinThousands: Join thousands of customers who've made the switch to smarter living. Our team is ready to help you design the perfect solution.
about.whyPremiumQualityDesc: Rigorously tested components engineered to outlast industry standards.
about.whyAdvancedAutomationDesc: Cutting-edge AI-ready tech that evolves with your space.
about.whyEnterpriseSecurityDesc: Military-grade encryption on every connected device.
about.whyAlwaysOnSupportDesc: Dedicated engineers available around the clock, every day.
about.whyExpertGuidanceDesc: White-glove installation and post-setup maintenance support.
about.whyCommunityDesc: A growing family of homes and businesses that trust Tek Node.
about.timelineFoundedDesc: Started with a vision to make smart homes accessible to every Indian household.
about.timelineExpandedDesc: Launched B2B vertical serving hotels, hospitals, and campuses across India.
about.timeline10KDesc: Crossed 10,000 happy customers and 25,000 successful deployments.
about.timelineNextGenDesc: Introduced AI-powered control systems and entered international markets.
about.t1Text: Tek Node transformed our hotel's energy management. Smart switches and sensors cut our electricity costs by 32% in the first quarter.
about.t2Text: The digital locks and smart knobs gave our home a premium feel at a very reasonable price. Installation was seamless with their guidance.
about.t3Text: We deployed Tek Node's gateway systems across 3 campuses. Reliability and support have been outstanding — zero downtime in 18 months.
about.t4Text: My clients love the smart knobs and switches. The sleek design integrates perfectly with modern interiors. My go-to automation partner.
about.t5Text: Industrial-grade reliability with consumer-friendly controls. Tek Node's automation solutions streamlined our factory floor operations remarkably.
about.faqA1: Tekunik provides smart home automation solutions including smart locks, sensors, cameras, switches, video door phones, and complete home automation systems for homes and businesses.
about.faqA2: Yes. Our expert technicians provide professional installation, setup, and configuration for all supported smart devices.
about.faqQ3: Can I request a custom smart home solution?
about.faqA3: Yes. You can submit an Installation Request through our website, and our team will prepare a customized automation proposal based on your requirements.
about.faqQ4: Do your products come with a warranty?
about.faqA4: Yes. All eligible products include manufacturer warranty. Warranty duration depends on the product category.
about.faqQ5: How can I track my order?
about.faqA5: After placing an order, you can track its status from your User Dashboard under My Orders.
about.faqQ6: Which payment methods do you accept?
about.faqA6: We support secure online payments as well as Cash on Delivery (where available).
about.faqA7: Yes. Orders can be cancelled before shipment. Refunds for eligible prepaid orders are processed according to our refund policy.
about.faqA8: You can contact us through the Contact page, WhatsApp, email, or phone support.

support24x7.title: 24x7 Support
support24x7.desc: Always here when you need us.
support24x7.longDesc: Our dedicated global support team is available round-the-clock to assist you with any questions, troubleshooting, or configuration support. You can reach us via live chat, phone, or email anytime.

voiceAssistant.title: Voice Assistant
voiceAssistant.longDesc: Seamlessly connect your smart ecosystem with leading voice controllers. Issue voice commands to adjust illumination levels, arm your property, or manage daily multi-device automation routines.

mobileApp.title: Mobile App Control
mobileApp.longDesc: Take complete control of your environment with our intuitive native iOS and Android application. Customize dashboard shortcuts, monitor system parameters, and modify settings in a unified UI.

remoteAccess.title: Remote Access
remoteAccess.longDesc: Whether you are at the office or travelling abroad, securely check real-time device logs, toggle power grids, and receive critical push alerts instantly over encrypted network tunnels.

cloudConnectivity.title: Cloud Connectivity
cloudConnectivity.longDesc: Powered by edge computing cluster arrays, device states synchronize instantly with millisecond latency. All cloud metrics are mirrored across decentralized node systems for continuous uptime.

energySaving.title: Energy Saving
energySaving.longDesc: Gain exhaustive historical utility metrics. Our smart algorithms isolate high-consumption nodes and recommend automated custom schedules to minimize waste and utility expenses.

easyInstallation.title: Easy Installation
easyInstallation.longDesc: Engineered around zero-invasive mounting interfaces. Our plug-and-play architectural components fit straight cleanly into existing wall matrices without expensive rewiring overhauls.

advancedSecurity.title: Advanced Security
advancedSecurity.longDesc: Equipped with AES-256 bit end-to-end data transport cryptography. Local authentication handshakes ensure external network intrusions cannot compromise the perimeter integrity of your home.

howWorks.title: How It Works

homeFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
homeFaq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our smart home ecosystem.

wiring.question: Do I need special wiring for Automate switches?
wiring.answer: No, Automate switches are designed to fit into your existing switchboards without requiring neutral wires or re-wiring.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Yes. We use bank-level AES-256 encryption. Your video feeds and data never leave our secure cloud environment.

internet.question: What happens if the internet goes down?
internet.answer: Your smart devices will continue to function normally via physical switches or local network controls if you are connected to the same Wi-Fi router.

installation.question: Do you offer professional installation?
installation.answer: Absolutely. We have certified professionals who can install and configure your smart home in a few hours.

subscription.question: Is there a monthly subscription fee?
subscription.answer: Basic app usage and device control is free. Optional premium plans can extend cloud storage for camera feeds.
